Difficult but Skill matchup : Hwei outranges Anivia but his effective range is typically close to your Q -> W range. And he’s one missed hwei E spell from dying each time he walks up post 6. And if he’s not QEing the wave to push: you can always use minion shield to walk up to avoid his EQ. And if he does QE the wave: you can walk up bait out the EE/dodge it and kill him. He can unfortunately kill any interaction in lane with his QE spam, but handshaking the lane is a net positive as he’s meant to be more of a lane bully. Scaling-wise he’s probably similar rather than being better: he’s not a late game monster and is prone to get picked off as he’s an immobile squishy mage.
